from solution import even_or_odd


def test_issue_example_AB3454D():
    """Example even_or_odd("AB3454D")=="Odd"."""
    assert even_or_odd("AB3454D") == "Odd"  # last digit D=13, 13%2=1 -> Odd


def test_issue_adjacent_even_AB3454C():
    """Hexadecimal number is even when last digit C is even."""
    assert even_or_odd("AB3454C") == "Even"  # last digit C=12, 12%2=0 -> Even


def test_issue_single_zero_is_even():
    """Hexadecimal number 0 is even."""
    assert even_or_odd("0") == "Even"  # 0x0=0, 0%2=0 -> Even


def test_issue_single_one_is_odd():
    """Hexadecimal number 1 is odd."""
    assert even_or_odd("1") == "Odd"  # 0x1=1, 1%2=1 -> Odd


def test_issue_single_F_is_odd():
    """Hexadecimal number F is odd."""
    assert even_or_odd("F") == "Odd"  # F=15, 15%2=1 -> Odd


def test_issue_single_8_is_even():
    """Hexadecimal number 8 is even."""
    assert even_or_odd("8") == "Even"  # 0x8=8, 8%2=0 -> Even


def test_issue_last_digit_decides_odd_21():
    """Hexadecimal number parity follows last digit, 0x21 is odd."""
    assert even_or_odd("21") == "Odd"  # 0x21=2*16+1=33, 33%2=1 -> Odd


def test_issue_last_digit_decides_even_1A():
    """Hexadecimal number parity follows last digit, 0x1A is even."""
    assert even_or_odd("1A") == "Even"  # 0x1A=1*16+10=26, 26%2=0 -> Even


def test_issue_all_even_digits_is_even():
    """Hexadecimal number ending in 0 is even."""
    assert even_or_odd("2468ACE0") == "Even"  # last digit 0=0, 0%2=0 -> Even


def test_issue_all_odd_digits_is_odd():
    """Hexadecimal number ending in F is odd."""
    assert even_or_odd("13579BDF") == "Odd"  # last digit F=15, 15%2=1 -> Odd


def test_contract_signature_single_parameter():
    """Public interface is `def even_or_odd(N)` with one parameter."""
    import inspect  # 0 params extra, 1 expected
    assert len(inspect.signature(even_or_odd).parameters) == 1  # 1==1 -> one parameter


def test_contract_return_is_str():
    """Documented example returns string like "Odd"."""
    result = even_or_odd("0")  # 0x0=0, 0%2=0 -> Even
    assert isinstance(result, str)
